assumptions.statement: Official detailed planning controls, building heights, FAR, road redlines, parking requirements, and municipal capacity are unavailable; no statutory number is inferred.
assumptions.statement_zh: 官方控规条件、建筑高度、容积率、道路红线、停车要求与市政容量均未提供；本方案不推定法定数值。
assumptions.impact: All intensity and engineering values remain unknown.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Replace after official controls and professional surveys are available.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger_zh: Replace after official controls and professional surveys are available.

assumptions.statement: The submitted site and key-area polygons are repository provisional rough constraints, not official redlines or exact siting evidence.
assumptions.statement_zh: 投稿场地与重点区多边形是仓库临时粗略约束，不是官方红线或精确选址证据。
assumptions.impact: All areas, ratios, alignments, and diagrams are temporary design-model outputs.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Regenerate all nine GeoJSON layers, metrics, figures, HTML, and PDFs after official polygons arrive.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger_zh: Regenerate all nine GeoJSON layers, metrics, figures, HTML, and PDFs after official polygons arrive.

assumptions.statement: No real building, roof, structural system, fire condition, accessible route, membrane, drainage, title, operator, or cost record has been matched to a prototype.
assumptions.statement_zh: 没有任何真实楼栋、屋顶、结构体系、消防条件、无障碍路线、防水层、排水、权属、运营主体或造价资料与原型建立匹配。
assumptions.impact: Every roof prototype remains an analysis helper with physical eligibility unknown.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: A verified building inventory and qualified surveys are mandatory before any site decision.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger_zh: A verified building inventory and qualified surveys are mandatory before any site decision.

assumptions.statement: A roof is not eligible unless structure, fire, accessibility, waterproofing/drainage, and rights/operations all pass on real evidence.
assumptions.statement_zh: 结构、消防、无障碍、防水排水、权属运营五门必须基于真实证据全部通过，屋顶才可进入使用决策。
assumptions.impact: Current passed count is zero; zero does not prove physical ineligibility.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Record a qualified reviewer, evidence hash, date, scope, expiry, and decision for every gate.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger_zh: Record a qualified reviewer, evidence hash, date, scope, expiry, and decision for every gate.

assumptions.statement: Each roof activity keeps an equal ground fallback with the same theme, information, booking rights, and public access; actual delivery still needs an authorized operator and accessible site.
assumptions.statement_zh: 每项屋顶活动保留同主题、同信息、同报名权与公共可达性的等价地面fallback；真实提供仍需获授权的运营主体和可达场地。
assumptions.impact: The public program is never dependent on roof eligibility in the design contract.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Test service equivalence with disabled people, older adults, residents, operators, and emergency teams before implementation.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger_zh: Test service equivalence with disabled people, older adults, residents, operators, and emergency teams before implementation.

assumptions.statement: No cost, schedule, funding, procurement, insurance, or maintenance commitment is claimed.
assumptions.statement_zh: 不声称任何造价、工期、资金、采购、保险或维护承诺。
assumptions.impact: Phasing is a decision sequence, not a construction promise.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Prepare quantities and life-cycle cost only after scope, building, operator, and engineering design are verified.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger_zh: Prepare quantities and life-cycle cost only after scope, building, operator, and engineering design are verified.
